title: 5 Things Philanthropic Leaders Need to Know About Democracy in 2026
discussion_signal: The post interprets Gallup/Kettering findings as a gap between support for democratic principles and willingness or confidence to defend them in practice. Replies extend the discussion toward social permission, civic habits, institutional guardrails, and the share of people who do not see democracy as the best form of government.
linked_research_question: How do civic and philanthropic discussions explain the distance between democratic commitment, local legitimacy, national performance, and willingness to act?
limits: The discussion is not a representative sample of democratic attitudes
Interpretive claims about civic habits are not causal findings
Public search discovery is not a platform-native Creator/API export
